subject: Lauching Shiny server with packages which aren't in CRAN

messages.author: 4645cc5ff080ea4f
messages.subject: Lauching Shiny server with packages which aren't in CRAN
parts:
Hi,

I am using few packages, for example rCharts and shinyIncubator, which are not in CRAN for my update. If I am using any package from CRAN, I just write 'library(packageName)' at the top of server.R before hosting and it works, as everybody knows. 

However, I am not sure what to do if I use, for example shinyIncubator, how should library be stated? How library should be installed? Because using just library(shinyIncubator) I get following error:




















And I am not sure what to do. I have tried add devtools::install_github("shiny-incubator", "rstudio") ,  but that didn't help too. I have tried add library(devtools) and etc, but nothing changed.
Maybe it is elementary question, but I would really appreciate any help.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Lauching Shiny server with packages which aren't in CRAN
parts:
Adomas,

If you have run the following (as you mentioned):

and Shiny Server is not finding the package, it is most likely because the package has not been installed globally (installed for s specific user only). Try installing the package with this command:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"devtools::install_github('shiny-incubator', 'rstudio')\""


Let us know if you see still have a problem with this.

Best,
Fereshteh

Error in loadNamespace(name) : there is no package called ‘devtools’

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('devtools',repos='http://cran.at.r-project.org/')\""

If you could suggest what else should I do, I would be really grateful.

Adomas

messages.author: 4645cc5ff080ea4f
messages.subject: Re: Lauching Shiny server with packages which aren't in CRAN
parts:
Hi,

I have finally launched application with shinyIncubator, thanks for help guys!

libcurl library was necessary for RCurl package, which is needed for devtools. However, I wasn't able install libcurl until libcurl-dev was present in my system. After installation everything worked fine. BTW, I am using CentOS system.

Thanks!
